title: Law to require impact reports for new hotels
summary: This bill would require developers to submit a community impact statement before building or converting a building into a transient hotel, covering effects on emergency services, utilities, traffic, need and neighborhood fit. The statement would be shared with the local borough president, council member and community board, and posted publicly at least 15 business days before a permit is issued. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
